title: Complete-split extremizers for the fractional triangle-cover deficit on chordal graphs
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main result of the author's preprint "Complete-Split Extremizers for a Fractional Triangle-Cover Functional on Chordal Graphs" (Erdős #81 series, Paper II). For a finite simple graph G let τ₃*(G) be its fractional triangle cover number (the least total weight of a nonnegative weighting of vertex pairs giving every triangle weight at least one on its edges) and Φ_τ(G) = |E(G)| − 2τ₃*(G). For every n ≥ 1, every chordal graph on n vertices satisfies Φ_τ(G) ≤ ⌊(2n + 1)²/24⌋, and equality is attained by a complete-split graph K_p ∨ K̄_q with p + q = n (Theorem 1.2). Chordality and fractional triangle covers use the definitions of two registered entries.
